structured.lessons: FM5 is refuted for good: the [FCCS] activation markers prove the mechanism ran live in both evals, so this is a true negative result rather than an instrumentation artifact. The v56-era +0.006 comparative-judging gain does not transfer to full-coverage packing — batching all segments against an in-video normal baseline dilutes anomaly saliency and collapses high-IoU precision. FM2 risk was not bounded by frozen top_k/merge/NMS because the failure entered upstream at the comparative scoring stage, so score-distribution shifts must be treated as first-class risk in future proposals. The coverage-recovery hypothesis is dead in this form: wrong-location-by-construction is not fixed by scanning everything comparatively, and the attempt costs +50s latency plus a ~3x mAP regression.
